For B19 and B32, use the restored address if it is the UK address you share. If it is a different address, **NEEDS-YOU** — supply your shared UK address directly on the form. Complete B19 only if your current address differs from B18.

For B20, use the restored number if it is your mobile. If it is your general telephone number, move it to B21 and mark B20 **NEEDS-YOU** for your mobile number.
